native_jpeg_color_repair.source_behavior: RoboTwin pkl2hdf5.py passes RGB camera arrays directly to cv2.imencode, which assumes BGR.
native_jpeg_color_repair.adapter_behavior: Decode the JPEG as RGB, then swap red and blue channels back to runtime head-camera RGB order.

recommendation.reason: The synchronized HDF5 conversion already repairs stored JPEG BGR ordering into runtime RGB. Applying swap_red_blue again at runtime is a double swap; preserve runtime RGB with identity.
